verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents broad, multi-backend model support. It runs text, voice, vision, image, video and 3D models from one runtime, runs any GGUF model pulled from Hugging Face or Ollama, offers a model gallery, and lets you plug in external gRPC backends. That covers LLMs and multi-modal models, but the evidence never names MoE or embedding models and never backs the 'hundreds of architectures' scale. missing for 10: explicit MoE support, explicit embedding-model support, evidence of hundreds of supported architectures, independent or hands-on corroboration.
